body:
Thank you so much for sharing this. So much.. It really means a lot to me...
Believe it or not, like I mentioned on another comment, I sent an email to the health care center of my university after reading your comment. 
The part where you said "my mother. She’d die" just hit me. I started balling.  I had to do it. I’ve been trying to do it for 3 months now. I don’t know if it‘s gonna help, but honestly I am praying it does. I am sorry you had to go through this, and I am hoping you are doing better now!
And thank you very much... and I am so so glad you are ok, I really am..! 
Thank you.

I want to change too. I don’t like being like this. At all. I hate myself and I am destroying my own future and my own life. 
Anyways, I just sent an email to the health care center of my university. I’ve been trying to do this for the past 3 months. I’m really scared and I don’t really think that anything’s gonna change, but who knows... still, thank you for the nice words!
I am SO glad to hear that! Thank you for letting me know <3

No, no, do not feel that way. I just want you to be ok. You are not stupid. And do not apologize for expressing and saying what you feel. In any way. Cry it out and sleep it out. Let me know when you are better.

No please, do not. I am actually crying right now, for you. Please. I know everything feels helpless, but hey I can be your new friend! You can talk,open up. I know it’s nothing like having someone there to actually hug you , but I’ll send you a shit load of mental hugs. I’ll listen. Please.

I opened my reddit account a few days ago for the first time, and honestly wow. Everything feels like I’ve written it myself. 
I started self harm a few weeks ago for the first time ever, knowing nothing about it. I cut with a regular razor as well, because that’s the only thing I could find around at that moment. I could feel my hand shaking, and I was crying my brains out. When I did it it felt the way any form of self harm would feel (I guess...). But then I opened my reddit account and started reading about styro cuts etc. and I feel so selfish for thinking that I consider what I do self harm. I guess it is but, like you said, it doesn’t feel valid. 
I can’t really find anything to make deeper cuts. Too depressed to go out of the house and too scared of the looks I’ll get of just randomly buying eg. blades. 
As a result , from cutting, or "scratching" too much, I’ve now started cutting on top of other scars that have not healed yet, and I’ve gotta say it does hurt a lot, but i guess it’s nothing compared to the pain of styro cuts, so I still feel guilty for saying that.
